recenter_predicate.priority: Recenter test precedes abs(error)<=1 and good_once handoff, so edge error-1/+1 can request recenter instead of acceptance.

count_budget.illustration_assumption: Monotone frequency, one exactly acceptable interior DAC; comparison errors are abstract +/-2 or0, not measured callback counts.
count_budget.conclusion: One recenter does not guarantee enough remaining checks for every possible monotone target. Actual slope/tolerance may broaden the acceptable interval. Existing failure-on-budget policy remains unchanged; this is not evidence of an observed callback capture failure.
